lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form visible nodes in a lattice-like configuration across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the lower lateral flank immediately posterior to the right pectoral fin.
